surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe input costs and labor unrest amid festive demand.
what_changed: Yarn prices surged between ₹50/kg and 66%, triggering severe input-cost shocks and early Diwali closure threats for loom units [b567711c9ed4, b62552cc0c7d].
Labor agitation over wages, hours, and police cases led to worker strikes, a 'Gaon Chalo' protest, and migrant exodus to UP and Bihar [d6a4b0e6a74b, 73dfcce5d3f4, a9383cbae2cf].
Diamond sector shortened its traditional Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Multiple major textile frauds and grey fabric defaults reported, including a ₹15.57 crore arrest and a ₹29.57 lakh Katargam default [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, cf2229091691].
Weavers forced to adopt a two-day weekly holiday and strict 15-day yarn payment rules ahead of Diwali [0c72a246c955].
Textile industry hit by pre-Diwali recessionary pressures and localized disruptions like a boiler blast in Udhna [691b478fe424, 28ff6df05700].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond boom raises expectations for a rollback of worker wage cuts and a shorter Diwali vacation [ff0f473e0921, 2b47ff4fa01a].
Surat-made fabric-coated airship successfully tested at 21km altitude, showcasing specialized technical textile capabilities [967bbbed3d39, 5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Monitor cash flow and working capital limits of upstream weaving units grappling with 15-day yarn payment mandates [0c72a246c955].
Track labor union negotiations and worker return rates post-Diwali to gauge operational continuity in embroidery and weaving.
